title: India Food Inflation & Supply-Chain Volatility Engine
description: Granular APMC Mandi wholesale price discovery, arrival shock anomalies (Z-scores), and inter-mandi spatial corridor stress metrics.

agri_engine.title: Agricultural Market Warehouse (WAL Mode)
agri_engine.description: Normalized APMC Mandi facts linked to LGD administrative boundaries and spatial coordinates.

v_price_movement_attribution.title: Why Did Prices Move? (Attribution & Seasonality)
v_price_movement_attribution.description: Automated plain-English explanations attributing price spikes and drops to weather shocks, festival demand surges, and crop harvest cycles.

v_live_mandi_prices.title: Live Mandi Prices Explorer (Empirical DCA & Wholesale)
v_live_mandi_prices.description: Human-readable view of daily wholesale modal prices, empirical DCA retail benchmark (Rs/kg), retail spread, windowed deltas, and joined corridor attributions.

v_live_price_deltas.title: Live Price Deltas & Trend Signals (Windowed)
v_live_price_deltas.description: Mathematical window functions (LAG OVER) calculating exact day-over-day and week-over-week modal price deltas and trend classifications.

v_dca_retail_benchmarks.title: DCA Daily Retail Benchmarks vs Terminal Wholesale
v_dca_retail_benchmarks.description: Official Department of Consumer Affairs (DCA) Price Monitoring Division retail prices joined directly with APMC terminal wholesale modal prices.

v_active_corridor_stress.title: Strategic Corridor Stress Alerts
v_active_corridor_stress.description: Active arbitrage spreads and supply slump Z-scores across production and terminal Mandis.

v_daily_national_summary.title: Daily National Summary
v_daily_national_summary.description: Average modal price, price range, and total arrival volume per commodity per day.

mandi_registry.title: Mandi Master Registry
mandi_registry.description: Wholesale APMC markets with official administrative names, states, districts, and coordinates.

daily_mandi_facts.title: Daily Mandi Facts (Raw Warehouse Table)
daily_mandi_facts.description: Underlying relational fact table linking mandi_id, commodity_id, and wholesale prices.

todays_cheapest_and_costliest_mandis.title: Top Arbitrage Opportunities Today (Costliest vs Cheapest Markets)
todays_cheapest_and_costliest_mandis.sql: SELECT reported_date, commodity, state, district, mandi_name, wholesale_price_rs_qtl, retail_equivalent_rs_kg, intraday_spread_rs_qtl FROM v_live_mandi_prices WHERE reported_date = (SELECT MAX(reported_date) FROM v_live_mandi_prices) ORDER BY wholesale_price_rs_qtl DESC LIMIT 50;

state_wise_price_summary.title: State-Wise Average Prices Today
state_wise_price_summary.sql: SELECT state, commodity, COUNT(mandi_name) AS reporting_mandis, ROUND(AVG(wholesale_price_rs_qtl), 2) AS avg_wholesale_rs_qtl, ROUND(AVG(retail_equivalent_rs_kg), 2) AS avg_retail_rs_kg, MIN(wholesale_price_rs_qtl) AS min_wholesale_rs_qtl, MAX(wholesale_price_rs_qtl) AS max_wholesale_rs_qtl FROM v_live_mandi_prices WHERE reported_date = (SELECT MAX(reported_date) FROM v_live_mandi_prices) GROUP BY state, commodity ORDER BY commodity, avg_wholesale_rs_qtl DESC;

active_supply_chain_shocks.title: Active Supply-Chain Shocks (High & Severe Stress)
active_supply_chain_shocks.sql: SELECT reported_date, commodity_name, origin_mandi, terminal_mandi, origin_modal_price, terminal_modal_price, price_spread, spread_pct, origin_arrival_shock_z, stress_level FROM v_active_corridor_stress WHERE stress_level IN ('HIGH', 'SEVERE') ORDER BY reported_date DESC, spread_pct DESC LIMIT 50;
